Retrieve a private user asset after authentication. When ``PRIVATE_MEDIA_CDN_BASE_URL`` is configured, redirects with HTTP 302 to the storage backend's short-lived signed URL; otherwise streams the file inline. The caller must be the asset owner or a staff member.

For **images** (**image_*** params) or **videos** (**video_*** params, or unified **media_*** fallbacks), optional query parameters append CDN hints ``w``, ``h``, ``f``, ``q`` to the redirect Location URL.

parameters.name: image_size
parameters.description: Image-only: logical box for CDN resizing. Invalid values behave as medium. Use ``custom`` with ``image_dimensions`` / ``media_dimensions``. ``original`` adds no sizing params.

parameters.name: image_format
parameters.description: Image codec hint (ignored for non-images). Defaults to ``webp``.

parameters.name: image_dimensions
parameters.description: With ``image_size=custom`` or ``media_size=custom``: WIDTHxHEIGHT in pixels (e.g. ``400x300``). Invalid values fall back to medium.

parameters.name: video_size
parameters.description: Video-only: same presets as ``image_size``; ``f`` becomes ``mp4`` or ``webm``.

parameters.name: video_format
parameters.description: Video container/codec hint (ignored for images). Defaults to ``mp4``.

parameters.name: video_dimensions
parameters.description: With ``video_size=custom`` / ``media_size=custom``: WIDTHxHEIGHT in pixels (same semantics as ``image_dimensions``).

parameters.name: media_size
parameters.description: Unified fallback when ``image_size`` / ``video_size`` is omitted; applies to whichever media type is being served.

parameters.name: media_format
parameters.description: Unified fallback: use ``webp`` / ``jpg`` / ``png`` for images or ``mp4`` / ``webm`` for video; mismatched hints are ignored per asset type.

parameters.name: media_dimensions
parameters.description: Unified ``custom`` WIDTHxHEIGHT when explicit ``*_dimensions`` is omitted.
